battle.name: 宋遼戰爭
battle.theater: 河北雄州、幽州與朔州戰線
battle.brief: 雍熙三年冬，宋太宗定策北伐，太平興國四年正月分三路出師，志在幽州。三月曹彬部敗於岐溝關，五月宋太宗督師於君子館一戰而潰，十一月楊繼業孤軍覆沒於陳家谷口，北伐全敗。埃及月牙劍雖不在此戰之列，但它那外彎不拔的單刃形制，正是後來遼金騎兵割馬彎刀的祖型。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 宋遼戰爭爆發於北宋太平興國四年（979）正月，開端是宋太宗雍熙三年北伐。一方是剛於同年五月滅北漢、盡有中原與河東的北宋：都城開封，皇帝趙光義坐鎮京師，兵源包括三衙禁軍（殿前司、侍衛馬軍司、侍衛步軍司）、河北沿邊軍州的鎮戍軍、編入軍籍的河北民兵（多以弓弩手為主，兼辦營田），以及隨軍轉運糧械的河東、河北民夫。一方是契丹耶律氏建立的遼國：此時景宗耶律賢年幼，太后蕭綽攝政，於同年改元統和，軍隊分契丹本部騎兵、漢軍州縣之兵、奚與渤海部眾，並有專司巡邏偵探的遊騎，以及隨軍攜行的帳幕、芻草、乳酪之屬。遼軍騎兵佔比高，人給雙馬甚至一兵三馬，遠距奔馳能力遠勝宋軍；宋軍則長於步弩齊射與守城器械，兩軍在兵種結構上正好互補而互相剋制。河北沿線的燕雲十六州屬遼而漢民多有逃歸宋境，遼追索逃戶、宋邊軍收納降戶，成為邊境摩擦的常態。第三方並非中立：北漢剛滅，遼軍曾數度南下救援；西邊党項諸部與東北女真諸部尚未成形，卻已構成遼的後方縱深與屏障。
countriesEn: Song–Liao fighting broke out at the opening of the Northern Song's Taiping Xingguo year four (979), beginning with Emperor Taizong's Yongxi northern campaign. On one side stood the Northern Song, which had destroyed Northern Han in May of that same year and now held the Central Plain and Hedong, with its capital at Kaifeng: Emperor Zhao Guangyi based himself in the capital, and the host drew on the palace guards of the three military commissions (Dianqian si, Shiwei Mayun si, Shiwei Bubing si), the garrison troops of the frontier prefectures along Hebei (Baozhou, Xiongzhou, Dingzhou, Mozhou, Yingzhou), the Hebei militia enrolled into the armies — mostly bow and crossbow men who also worked the garrison fields — and the porters of Hedong and Hebei who moved grain and engines with the columns. On the other stood the Liao state founded by the Khitan Yelü clan: Jingzong Yelü Xian was still a child, the empress dowager Xiao (Xiao Chuo) exercised power, and the era name was changed to Tonghe in that very year. Liao troops were divided into Khitan cavalry proper, Han troops from the prefectures and counties, Xi and Bohai contingents, together with scouting parties of mounted scouts and the felt tents, fodder and dairy provisions that travelled with the column. Liao cavalry made up a high share of the force, with two horses to a rider and sometimes three horses to one man, so their endurance on long rides far exceeded the Song's; the Song were strong in massed infantry fire from bows and crossbows and in siege equipment, and the two armies matched one another and countered one another exactly in the structure of their troops. The Sixteen Prefectures of Yan and Yun along the Hebei frontier belonged to Liao while many Han inhabitants had fled into Song territory; Liao pursued the runaways in order to close the registers, and Song frontier troops profited by taking in surrendered households, so this friction was the everyday condition of the border. The third parties were not neutral: with Northern Han newly fallen, Liao armies had marched south more than once to relieve it, and the Tangut peoples of the west and the Jurchen tribes of the north-east had not yet formed states, yet already constituted Liao's rear depth and shield.
people: 宋太宗趙光義是北伐的決策者與最高統帥：他在雍熙三年冬季定策北伐，北伐受挫後仍御駕親至大名督戰，意圖以身臨前線挽回士氣，最終在君子館之敗中乘輦車退走，回京後下詔責己。東路主帥曹彬是平巴蜀、下江南的名將，此番奉命趨幽州，進度遲緩被太宗嚴檄催促，遂下令盡棄攻城器械、輕裝疾行，也因此把全軍置於無所憑藉的野地之中；田重進、劉楨分統中路，東路之外別設策應之師。西路以檢校太師潘美為主將、監軍王侁隨軍，原要與楊繼業部策應夾擊朔州，但潘美與王侁不待詔符而擅自提前出師，斷送了楊繼業的接應。楊繼業本名重貴，麟州新秦人，時人稱「楊無敵」，自代北歸宋後歷守邊鎮，屢破北漢與契丹；其子楊延昭隨軍，星夜馳援父軍不及，被圍於陳家谷口，與父相繼陣亡。遼方主腦是攝政的蕭太后，她以漢人與漢地物資支援軍需，起用耶律休哥、耶律斜軫兄弟專掌北面兵權，又命韓德昌統南面大軍；休哥善於不以力敵而以疲敵，屢以精騎截糧焚械；斜軫勇於先鋒陷陣，是陳家谷口伏擊的主要執行者。遼將劉守敬南攻太原兵敗，則說明北漢覆亡之初，遼與宋的邊界仍未真正安定。
peopleEn: Emperor Song Taizong Zhao Guangyi was both the decision maker and the supreme commander of the campaign: he settled on the plan for the northern expedition in the winter of the Yongxi era, and even after the setbacks he drove personally to Daming to direct the front, meaning to revive the army's morale by his presence, and in the end he withdrew in a covered carriage after the defeat at Junziguan, then issued an edict blaming himself on his return to the capital. Cao Bin, commander of the eastern route, was the famous general who had pacified Bashu and taken Jiangnan down; charged now with driving on Yuzhou, he was pressed hard by the emperor's urgent edicts over his slow progress, and so ordered the siege engines cast away and the column to march light and fast — thereby leaving the entire army in open country with nothing to rely on. Tian Chongjin and Liu Zhen led the central column, with separate covering forces posted beyond the eastern route. On the western route the general was Pan Mei, the Grand Master of the Palace, with the supervisor Wang Song accompanying him; the plan was to strike朔州 in concert with Yang Jieye's column, but Pan Mei and Wang Song advanced without waiting for the imperial tally, and so destroyed the link that would have brought Yang Jieye support. Yang Jieye, born Chonggui, of Xinqin in Luzhou, was known to his contemporaries as Yang the Invincible; since his submission to Song from the Dai border he had held frontier towns and repeatedly beaten Northern Han and the Khitans. His son Yang Yanzhao served with him, rode through the night to reach his father's army too late, and was encircled at Chenjiagu Pass, where father and son fell in succession. The brain of the Liao side was the regent, the empress dowager Xiao, who supported the war effort with Han officials and the produce of Han territory, and who set the brothers Yelü Xiuge and Yelü Xiezhen in charge of the northern armies while ordering Han Dechang to command the southern host. Xiuge was skilled at wearing an enemy down rather than matching force with force, repeatedly cutting the grain road and burning the engines with picked cavalry; Xiezhen dared to break into the vanguard, and was the chief executor of the ambush at Chenjiagu Pass. The defeat of the Liao general Liu Shoujing in his attack on Taiyuan shows that the Liao–Song frontier was not yet truly settled even after the fall of Northern Han.
kits: 本卡的埃及月牙劍不會出現在北宋的營壘或旗門之下：它是一件青銅時代的單刃外彎刀，砍入不需拔刀，這種形制在宋代沒有任何考古或文獻的對應。它的價值在譜系而不在戰場：從埃及的月牙劍，經兩河流域與伊朗高原的弧刃短刀，到十一至十三世紀伊斯蘭世界的雙刃彎刀，再至十五世紀蒙古與帖木兒系的單刃彎刀，最後成為明代佩刀與薙刀的一支；而遼與後來的金，騎兵手中正配著這類短弧刃刀，配上套索與標槍，用於割馬、斬將、勒頸。宋軍自己的近戰主力則是漢代相傳的環首直刀與宋式長柄斬馬刀，配合白刃槍、矛、錘、鳴鐧，步戰全靠盾牌的邊緣與刺突節奏，不靠揮砍。真正左右宋遼戰局的遠程器械是弓弩：神臂弓臂長約三尺五寸，須腰引二人之力，射程約三百步，記載稱一箭可洞穿精甲；步弩、橫弩、車弩層次配置，遠射之外再以藤牌、竹牌與皮蒙盾承受箭石。火藥兵器已在役，霹靂砲、火龍砲、飛火與陶製的震天雷多屬守城與破壞工事之用。攻城與野戰另有撞車、雲梯、壕車、拒馬、鹿角與木構攻城塔。遼軍則以皮甲、札甲、細甲護身，弓硬而箭利，配帳幕隨軍、輜重車隊與馬群作戰；其後勤極簡，游牧的芻草與乳酪隨軍而行，糧食多取自漢地倉場與沿途州縣。真正拖垮宋軍的裝備問題不在兵器，而在馬匹與糧食：河北邊軍馬源不足，北伐糧草要從汴京經汴河、漳河轉入河北，末段冰泮未通而須陸運數百里，糧船屢滯，才是曹彬遲進的真正原因。
kitsEn: The Egyptian khopesh on this card never appeared in a Northern Song camp or before a command tent: it is a Bronze Age single-edged blade curved outward, used without drawing back after the cut, and no form of it has any archaeological or textual counterpart in the Song. Its value lies in a lineage rather than on a battlefield: from the Egyptian khopesh, through the crescent-edged short swords of Mesopotamia and the Iranian plateau, to the double-edged curved swords of the Islamic world of the eleventh to thirteenth centuries, and on to the single-edged sabres of the Mongol and Timurid lines in the fifteenth century, which finally became one of the branches of the Ming sabre and the glaive. Liao, and later Jin, cavalry did carry that sort of short curved blade, together with lasso and javelin, for cutting horses, taking heads and throttling men. The Song close combat core was the ring-pommel straight sword handed down since the Han and the long-handled horse-cutting sabre of Song make, used with the white-bladed spear, the mao, the war hammer and the chain mace; infantry work depended on the edge of the shield and the rhythm of the thrust, never on the swing. The ranged instruments that truly decided Song–Liao fighting were bows and crossbows. The divine arm bow had a stock about three chi and five cun long, had to be drawn with the waist by two men, and shot about three hundred paces; the chronicles say one bolt could pierce a well-made coat of mail. Foot crossbows, horizontal crossbows and bed crossbows were layered in turn, the longer ranges answered by heavier bows, while lighter troops carried rattan shields, bamboo shields and hide-covered shields to absorb arrows and stones. Gunpowder weapons were already in service: the thunder crash mortar, the fire dragon mortar, flying fire and the ceramic concussion mine were used mainly for defence of walls and for breaking works. Siege and field gear included the ram, the scaling ladder, the covered wagon, the cheval de frise, the spiked abatis and timber towers for storming walls. The Liao protected themselves with hide, lamellar and fine mail, using bows stiff and arrows sharp, and marched with tents, wagon trains and herds of horses; their logistics were extremely simple, since the fodder and dairy of the pastoral way travelled with the column and grain was taken from Han granaries and from the prefectures along the route. What actually broke the Song army was not its weapons but its horses and grain: the Hebei frontier garrison was short of horses, and the grain for the expedition had to run from Bianjing by the Bian and Zhang rivers into Hebei, the last leg by land for several hundred paces because the ice had not yet broken and the river was not open, so the grain boats were held up again and again. That, not the enemy's sword arm, was the true reason Cao Bin advanced so slowly.
tactics: 雍熙北伐的戰術意圖是以多路大進換取速決：東路曹彬趨幽州，中路田重進、劉楨自河北中部壓上，西路潘美、楊繼業自太原方向出朔州、代州，企圖斷遼右翼，三路同時壓上，好讓蕭太后無法判斷主攻所在。曹彬初段攜帶攻城器械行軍，糧車未至即逗留四十餘日，太宗使者檄至，責其失期，遂令盡棄攻城器械、輕裝疾行；此舉雖提速，卻使大軍離開後勤、暴露於平原，士卒疲於奔命而未及列陣。遼軍全程不與宋軍正面對攻，只以遊騎貼近遲滯、斷絕糧道與傳令、焚燒攻城器械，逼宋軍在野外結營。三月岐溝關，遼軍先以小股挑釁使宋軍陣腳浮動，再以精騎萬餘乘隙突入營陣，攻入寨柵、焚其糧草，曹彬中箭負傷，軍遂大潰。嗣後蕭太后與韓德昌率大軍南下直指宋太宗所在，連攻十餘日，宋軍士疲糧盡，五月於君子館一戰崩潰，太宗乘輦車退走，遼軍追至拒馬河一線，因河北諸城拒守而糧秣難繼乃退。十一月陳家谷口，遼軍已先獲宋軍行程，耶律斜軫以先鋒挑戰，耶律休哥率精騎繞出宋軍側後，攻破營壘，楊繼業自午至夜力戰不止，父子相繼死於亂軍。事後宋廷收兵退守諸關，塞下城壘、廣置屯田，整補禁軍、收養精騎、整頓監牧以補馬源，戰略由攻轉守。
tacticsEn: The tactical idea behind the Yongxi northern expedition was to convert a many-pronged advance into a decision: Cao Bin on the eastern route drove for Yuzhou, Tian Chongjin and Liu Zhen pressed up through central Hebei, and Pan Mei with Yang Jieye came out of Taiyuan toward Shuozhou and Daizhou in the west, aiming to cut Liao's right flank, with all three routes pressing at once so that the empress dowager Xiao could not tell where the main blow would fall. Cao Bin's column at first moved with its siege engines and waited more than forty days because the grain wagons had not come; when the emperor's envoys arrived with urgent edicts blaming him for missing his dates, he ordered the engines abandoned and the march made light and fast. The speed was gained, but the army was pulled away from its supply and exposed on the plain, its soldiers too worn by forced marching to get into formation. The Liao never met the Song in a set battle along the front. They rode close, lagged the column, cut the grain road and the messengers, burned the siege engines, and forced the Song to camp in open country. At Qigou Pass in March they first sent small parties to harass and unsettle the Song line, then drove picked cavalry of more than ten thousand into the gap, broke into the stockade and burned the grain; Cao Bin was wounded by an arrow and the army collapsed. After that the empress dowager Xiao and Han Dechang marched south straight for the emperor's own position, attacked for more than ten days, and the Song, exhausted and out of grain, broke at Junziguan in May; the emperor withdrew in a covered carriage, and the Liao pursued to the Juma river line before the resistance of the Hebei cities and their own difficulty in carrying grain brought them back. At Chenjiagu Pass in November the Liao already knew the Song timetable: Yelü Xiezhen engaged with the vanguard while Yelü Xiuge took picked cavalry round the Song flank, broke the camp, and Yang Jieye fought from midday into the night until he and his son lay dead in the rout. Afterwards the Song court recalled the troops behind the passes, built walls and stockades below the frontier, extended the garrison fields, filled the gaps in the palace guards, collected the pick of the cavalry, and reorganised the imperial pastures to make up the shortage of horses. The strategy turned from attacking to defending.
data: 北伐自雍熙三年（978）冬定策，至太平興國四年（979）正月出師，其間時間表多有記載：正月各路北進，三月曹彬一部敗於岐溝關，四月宋太宗自大名督師，五月前線崩潰、兵敗回京，秋季下詔責己，十一月楊繼業部覆沒於陳家谷口，同年十二月遼景宗崩、蕭太后以幼主臨朝稱制。距離與行程是失敗的關鍵：自開封至幽州約一千二百里，曹彬大軍攜攻城器械與糧車同行，行程竟拖至四十餘日；糧食自汴京沿汴河、漳河轉入河北，末段須陸運數百里，冰泮之前河面未通，糧船屢為水患與淺澗所阻，軍隊因而屢停待糧。兵員方面，各書記載互有出入，概稱出兵數十萬而無一致確數，可信者只知東路一路即傾注主力於曹彬麾下；遼軍則以精兵見長，岐溝關一役投入精騎萬餘，陳家谷口之役斜軫、休哥兩部合計亦以萬計，宋西路楊繼業所部記載為數萬眾。損失方面，記曹彬一路士卒死者數萬、器甲糧資盡棄，陳家谷口一戰全軍覆沒、楊繼業身被數創，數字諸說並存，不宜視為精確統計。器械性能亦有量度可據：神臂弓射程約三百步，記載稱一箭可洞貫二人之甲；步弩、橫弩依次遞減射程以補射。幽州城郭完固、樓堞密布，宋軍即使兵臨城下亦難猝拔。
dataEn: The expedition was planned in the winter of the Yongxi era (978) and marched in the first month of Taiping Xingguo (979), and the timetable of those months is often recorded: the columns moved north in the first month; in March Cao Bin's force was beaten at Qigou Pass; in April Taizong came himself from Daming to direct the front; in May the line collapsed and the court returned to the capital in defeat; in the autumn an edict blamed the emperor himself; in November Yang Jieye's force was destroyed at Chenjiagu Pass; and in December of the same year the Liao emperor Jingzong died, leaving the empress dowager Xiao to rule for her young son. Distance and pace were the crux of the failure. From Bianjing to Yuzhou is about twelve hundred li, and Cao Bin's host, moving with siege engines and grain wagons, dragged the march out beyond forty days. Grain ran from Bianjing by the Bian and Zhang rivers into Hebei, the last several hundred li by land, because before the ice broke the river was not navigable and the grain boats were repeatedly held up by flood and shoals, so the army stopped and waited for grain over and over. On numbers of men the records differ and the general statement is of several hundred thousand without a single consistent figure; what can be trusted is only that the eastern route concentrated the main force under Cao Bin. The Liao were strong in picked troops: more than ten thousand cavalry were committed at Qigou Pass, and Xiezhen's and Xiuge's columns together again numbered by the ten thousand at Chenjiagu Pass, while Yang Jieye's western column is recorded as several tens of thousands. On losses, Cao Bin's route is recorded as leaving several thousand dead with armour and grain thrown away, and at Chenjiagu Pass the whole force was destroyed with Yang Jieye bearing many wounds; these figures are various and should not be treated as exact statistics. The performance of the weapons can be measured: the divine arm bow shot about three hundred paces, and the chronicles say one bolt could pierce the mail of two men; foot crossbows and horizontal crossbows answered with progressively shorter ranges. Yuzhou's walls were sound and its towers and crenellations dense, so even with the Song at its gates the city could not be taken quickly.
cause: 北伐的直接起因，是北宋統一大業僅剩最後一塊補丁。開寶九年（975）南唐亡，太平興國初年削平荊南、湖南，太平興國四年（979）正月宋軍圍太原、五月北漢劉繼元出降，河東歸宋，連成一條從淮水到雁門的北界；宋太宗認為只要再取幽州、盡有雲中，就能把契丹擋在塞外，完成其「守四夷、拓天下」的帝業。燕雲十六州自後唐末割與契丹，河北屏障盡失，是宋廷記挂百年的心病；蕭太后攝政後，遼一面整軍改制、改元統和、起漢人為官，一面遣使聘宋、示以和好，宋廷不納，於是再以兵決之。次一原因在邊境：燕雲漢戶多有逃入宋境，遼每年追索括戶，宋邊軍亦以收納降戶為利，兩國在沿邊的掠奪與反掠奪年年發生，積累成全面衝突的藉口。第三是宋太宗個人的政治需要：其即位以來朝野對藩鎮與年長諸王的疑慮未消，北伐一舉成功即可壓過一切非議，一旦失敗則威信受損。內因方面，宋廷於北伐前一年才剛完成削平後周舊政與收復河東的重整，禁軍雖多而精銳未集，河北屯田與馬政積弊未除，遠征前線的準備其實不足。
causeEn: The immediate occasion for the campaign was that only one last patch was missing from the Northern Song's work of unification. Nan Tang fell in the ninth year of Kaibao (975), Jingnan and Hunan were put down in the opening years of Taiping Xingguo, and in the first month of Taiping Xingguo year four (979) the Song besieged Taiyuan, with Liu Jiuyuan of Northern Han surrendering in May and Hedong returning to Song, so that a northern line now ran unbroken from the Huai to Yanmen. Taizong believed that if he could take Yuzhou and hold Yunzhong, the Khitans would be shut outside the passes and his imperial design of guarding the four quarters and enlarging the realm would be complete. The Sixteen Prefectures of Yan and Yun had been ceded to the Khitans at the end of Later Tang, leaving the northern shield lost — a wound the Song court had nursed for a century. After taking power as regent, the empress dowager Xiao reorganised the Liao army and administration, changed the era to Tonghe and employed Han officials, while also sending envoys to Song with a show of peace, which the Song court refused, so the two sides once again decided the matter by arms. A second cause lay on the frontier: many Han households of Yan and Yun had fled into Song territory, Liao pursued them every year to close the registers, Song frontier troops profited by taking in the surrendered, and the raids and counter-raids along the border in both directions were a yearly affair that accumulated into the pretext for a general war. Third was Taizong's own political need: the doubts of the court about the military governors and his elder brothers had never been quieted since his accession, a successful northern campaign would have drowned all such talk, and a failure would cost him authority. On the domestic side, the court had only just finished the great rearrangement that carried out the suppression of the old Later Zhou institutions and the recovery of Hedong in the year before the expedition; the palace guards were numerous but their picked ranks were not yet gathered, the garrison fields of Hebei and the horse administration still carried old abuses, and the preparation of the distant front line was in truth insufficient.
impact: 雍熙北伐的失敗改變了北宋的整個國策。宋由攻轉守，河北防禦體制重整：保州等邊口的塞防工程大興，諸城修城浚壕，屯田與義倉在沿邊推廣，禁軍折損後以精兵補之，監牧之制亦整頓以補馬源。這套「守內虛外」的取向在往後數十年被反覆討論，成為冗官冗兵之弊的源頭之一，也為慶曆新政時的裁汰與強干弱枝之議埋下伏線。將才方面，楊繼業陣亡使北宋失了一員久歷北疆的老將，其子楊延昭卻在此役中嶄露頭角，日後鎮守河東、河北，成為對遼防務的名將，父子之命由此與宋遼邊界糾纏數十年。技術層面上，長期攻城與守城把火藥兵器推向實用：宋城的陶製震天雷與霹靂砲是這一時期的產物，遼軍攻宋城亦用飛火與火箭，宋軍守城則倚神臂弓與床子弩構成遠射火網。長期格局則是：此後二十五年雙方在河北拉鋸，遼於咸平末與景德初大舉南下，景德元年澶州之戰宋軍以城頭砲火與弩陣抵禦遼軍攻城器械，翌年遂有澶淵之盟，以歲賜銀絹換得百餘年邊境相安；其後再訂慶曆和議，增歲賜而開榷場。燕雲十六州則直到北宋覆亡仍未收復。兵器譜系上，這場戰爭所延續的北方騎兵單刃弧刀傳統，終於在蒙古時代成熟為彎刀，說明「砍下不拔」的外彎單刃一直是遊牧騎兵的合用之刃，而宋軍以刺突為主的環首直刀則代表另一條技術路線。
impactEn: The failure of the Yongxi expedition reshaped the whole policy of the Northern Song. China passed from attacking to defending, and the Hebei defence system was rebuilt: the frontier works at passes such as Baozhou were greatly extended, the cities were walled and their moats dredged, garrison fields and granaries were pushed forward along the border, the gaps in the palace guards were filled with picked troops, and the administration of the imperial pastures was reorganised to make up the shortage of horses. This attitude of strengthening the interior while the outer line stood empty was argued over for decades afterwards, became one of the sources of the redundancy in offices and soldiers, and laid the groundwork for the retrenchment and the debate on strengthening the trunk and weakening the branches in the Qingli reforms. As for generals, Yang Jieye's death cost the Song a veteran of the northern marches, while his son Yang Yanzhao first showed his mettle in this very campaign and afterwards held Hedong and Hebei, becoming a famous defender against Liao; the family's fate was henceforth bound up with the Song–Liao frontier for decades. On the technical level, long years of siege and defence pushed gunpowder weapons into practical service: the ceramic concussion mine and the thunder crash mortar found in Song towns belong to this period, Liao besiegers used flying fire and fire arrows against Song walls, and Song defenders met them with a web of distant fire built from divine arm bows and bed crossbows. The long-term pattern was this: for twenty-five years the two sides pulled and hauled at each other in Hebei, Liao marched south in force at the end of the Xianping era and again at the beginning of the Jingde era, and at the battle of Chanzhou in the first year of Jingde the Song met the Liao siege engines with gunpowder fire and crossbow walls from the towers. The following year came the treaty of Chanyuan, in which annual payments of silver and silk bought more than a century of quiet along the border; later came the Qingli settlement, with larger payments and opened market towns. The Sixteen Prefectures of Yan and Yun were still not recovered when the Northern Song fell. As for the lineage of arms, the single-edged curved sword of the northern horsemen carried on by this war only matured into the sabre in the Mongol age, which shows that the outward-curved blade that does not need to be drawn back was always the working edge of the pastoral horseman, while the ring-pommel straight sword, built for the thrust, marked a different technical road.
result: 雍熙北伐三路皆敗：東路曹彬岐溝關潰後被貶官，次年病卒；中路退兵；西路潘美與楊繼業部全軍覆沒於陳家谷口，主帥楊繼業與其子楊延昭皆死於陣。宋太宗詔責己，罷數路統帥，收兵退守，河北諸州重啟城防；遼軍追至雄州、大名一帶，因宋軍據城死守而糧秣難繼，掠無所獲乃還。九月遼景宗再傾十萬眾南下攻鎮州，於徐河、滿城一線被宋軍擊退，遼軍退易州，宋遼邊界重回原狀。以宋而言，北伐失敗意味著「取燕雲」的帝業暫時破滅，北宋轉入長期消耗與守勢，宋軍精銳折損、財力與民力耗於沿邊屯戍，宋太宗本人也自此不再親征。以遼而言，蕭太后以大勝鞏固攝政，休哥、斜軫等宿將權力更重，統和二十餘年國勢稱盛，宋遼之間的形勢也隨之改變。於是兩國之間形成一條以白溝河、瓦橋關一線為界的長期對峙：雙方不再求全勝，只求不讓對方奪去燕雲。最終，979年這場敗仗拉開的消耗戰一直延續到宣和七年——遼為金所敗，宋金聯手滅遼，宋室北伐的目標在百四十六年後由金人代為完成，而那句「封禪」與「燕雲」的執念，遂成為北宋末年亡國時仍被翻出的舊帳。
resultEn: All three routes of the Yongxi expedition failed. On the eastern route Cao Bin was demoted after the rout at Qigou Pass and died of illness the following year; the central route fell back; on the western route Pan Mei and Yang Jieye's force was wiped out at Chenjiagu Pass, the commander Yang Jieye and his son Yang Yanzhao both dying in the battle. Taizong issued an edict blaming himself, dismissed the commanders of several routes, recalled the troops behind the passes and shut the cities of Hebei once more. The Liao pursued as far as Xiongzhou and Daming, but because the Song held the cities obstinately and their own grain could not be carried on, they took what they could and withdrew. In the ninth month the Liao emperor Jingzong again poured a hundred thousand men south against Zhenzhou, were beaten back along the Xu and Mancheng lines, and retired to Yizhou, and the Song–Liao border returned to its old shape. For the Song, the defeat meant that the imperial design of taking Yan and Yun was broken for the time, that the Northern Song settled into a long attritional defence, that the picked ranks of the army were thinned and the treasury and the people's strength consumed by the garrisons along the border, and that Taizong himself never again led an army in the field. For the Liao, the great victory confirmed the regency of the empress dowager Xiao, gave greater power to seasoned generals such as Xiuge and Xiezhen, and made the two and a half decades of the Tonghe era the height of the state's strength, with the balance between Song and Liao shifting accordingly. Thus a long confrontation took shape along a frontier marked by the White Ditch river and Waguan Pass: neither side sought total victory any more, only that the other should not take Yan and Yun. In the end the attritional war opened by the defeat of 979 ran on until the seventh year of Xuanhe, when Liao was beaten by Jin and Song and Jin together destroyed it, and the Song's northern goal was carried out by the Jurchen one hundred and forty-six years later; and the obsession with the Fengshan sacrifice and with Yan and Yun was one of the old debts turned over again when the Northern Song perished.
